summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the ReviewConsole DARK-MODE CONTRAST fixes flagged in iteration_18 (auth bypassed, dev@local Owner, preview URL). The previously HIGH bug is FIXED. Publish tab: publish-title-<id> ('What is Emergent?') navigates to /review/what-is-emergent and review-page renders; 'Review page' buttons are indigo-400 and Publish buttons are white-on-dark. LIGHT MODE REGRESSION PASSED: theme-toggle flipped html.dark off and wrote localStorage 'light'; Assignments + Publish re-render with dark button bg rgb(24,24,27)/white text and no dark leftovers (only pre-existing sub-AA text-zinc-400 '(page)' at 2.56:1). INLINE REVIEW REGRESSION (dark) PASSED: /review/what-is-emergent body text 13.46:1, verdict chip 'Looks correct' saved (toast 'Verdict saved', chip inverts to white/zinc-900), Range selection produced selection-comment-btn -> review-composer (input bg rgb(39,39,42) text rgb(244,244,245)) -> comment pinned with quoted anchor into review-comments-rail. ONE REMAINING DARK-MODE DEFECT FOUND (new, previously unverifiable because the inbox was empty): the Review Inbox comment BODY is effectively invisible in dark mode - see frontend_issues. 0 JS console errors (only the benign 404 for a static asset). CLEANUP: 18 assignments deleted via UI, TEST_ comments + verdict deleted via /app/test_reports/cleanup_iter19.py - verified 0 comments / 0 verdicts on what-is-emergent, 0 published docs, 18 assignments remaining (all vishal.k@emergent.sh, pre-existing).

critical_code_review_comments: The dark-mode fix pass was applied element-by-element and it missed exactly the branch that was not rendered during the previous test run (the inbox card, which only renders when a comment exists). Extract StatusPill-style shared classes for 'card body text' / 'muted text' / 'primary button' into constants (or use the hsl(var(--foreground)) tokens ReviewPage already uses) so a theme variant physically cannot be forgotten in one branch.
ReviewConsole.jsx is still 482 lines with all 4 tabs inline; splitting into ReviewOverview/ReviewAssignments/ReviewInbox/ReviewPublish would make these per-branch styling misses reviewable.

createAssignment fires one POST per selected scope via Promise.allSettled (18 parallel requests for one tab); consider a bulk endpoint - it worked but is chatty and partially-failing states are only surfaced as a toast.

rca_of_the_issue: The iteration_18 HIGH bug (assign-scope-list labels 1.70-2.24:1 blocking assignment creation in dark mode) is genuinely fixed: dark:text-indigo-400 / dark:text-zinc-300 / dark:text-zinc-400 now yield 5.94/11.99/6.91:1 and dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 replaced the near-white row hover; primary buttons got dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900 so they no longer merge into dark:bg-zinc-900 cards. The one remaining miss is the Review Inbox comment body (line 423, text-zinc-700 with no dark variant, 1.70:1) - it escaped both the previous fix pass and the previous test because the inbox has no comments in the seeded DB, so the card never rendered. Reproduce: POST a comment on any doc, open /admin/review in dark theme -> Review Inbox; the comment text is dark-grey on near-black.
